title: Will Jenna Dewan and their partner be eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Nov 3, 2026?
rules: If Jenna Dewan and their partner are officially eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
The declaration must be made through official program broadcast, website, verified social media, or press releases.
If the season is canceled without declaring eliminations, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Elimination includes being voted off, evicted, knocked out, removed from further contention, voluntary withdrawal, disqualification, or producer removal.
Multiple simultaneous eliminations count.
Initial elimination counts even if the contestant later returns.

Doesn't count for payout
Eliminations immediately reversed in the same episode don't count.
Temporary suspensions, medical holds, or being runner-up in the finale don't count as elimination.

blind.reasoning: Only one episode airs before the deadline: Disney Night on Monday, Nov 2, which ends about 03:00 UTC Nov 3, before the market closes. Eight couples remain, and Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy are tied for second on the combined judges' leaderboard (74/80). They were safe in the double elimination that used fan votes from two weeks, so a likely single elimination is very unlikely to hit them. The main risk is backlash from fans over Val's suspension, or a surprise double elimination.
blind.falsifier: Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy are announced as eliminated (or withdraw) at the end of the Monday, November 2 Disney Night episode.

final.reasoning: The 10.5% midpoint is close to the uniform one-in-eight risk, but Dewan is near the top of the judges' leaderboard and survived the latest vote. Only one episode, on Nov 2, falls before the deadline, so I stay well below the market.
